draft.subject: Following up after our onboarding call
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Thanks for making time for the onboarding call last week. Picking up where we left off: the next step is getting a first project started, since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and real work beats a placeholder.
